focus.title: 本周国际经贸主线：美欧对华关税与出口管制持续加码，全球供应链重构加速
focus.summary: 本周，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）宣布将多家中国实体列入出口管制实体清单，涉及半导体、人工智能及量子计算领域；欧盟委员会同步推进对华电动汽车反补贴调查的终裁程序，拟将关税税率上调至最高35%。同时，美国贸易代表办公室（USTR）表示将启动对华301条款关税的四年期复审，可能进一步调整对华商品税率。分析认为，美欧在关键科技领域的对华限制正形成“协同效应”，叠加全球供应链“去风险化”趋势，中国出海企业面临更复杂的合规环境，需加快供应链多元化布局，并强化出口管制合规体系建设。
focus.source: 综合美国商务部BIS、欧盟委员会、USTR公告 · 本周
focus.title_en: This Week's Global Trade Focus: US-EU Escalate Tariffs and Export Controls on China, Accelerating Supply Chain Restructuring
focus.summary_en: This week, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) added several Chinese entities to the Entity List, targeting semiconductors, AI, and quantum computing. Meanwhile, the European Commission advanced its anti-subsidy probe into Chinese EVs, proposing tariffs up to 35%. The USTR also signaled a four-year review of Section 301 tariffs on China, potentially adjusting rates. These coordinated restrictions reflect a 'de-risking' trend, urging Chinese companies to diversify supply chains and strengthen export compliance.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. BIS, European Commission, USTR announcements · this week

case.title: 最高法发布跨境数据纠纷典型案例：明确企业数据出境合规边界
case.summary: 本周，最高人民法院发布一批涉外商事海事典型案例，其中一起涉及跨境数据流动的合同纠纷案引发关注。案情为：某中国科技公司与境外合作方签订数据处理协议，因未按约定完成数据出境安全评估，导致合同履行受阻，境外方索赔违约损失。法院认定，数据出境合规义务属于合同项下法定义务，企业未履行导致合同目的不能实现的，应承担违约责任。该案例明确，中国企业在跨境业务中必须将数据出境安全评估、个人信息保护影响评估等作为合同履行的前置条件，否则将面临商业与法律双重风险。
case.source: 来源：最高人民法院典型案例发布 · 2026年8月
case.title_en: SPC Publishes Typical Cross-Border Data Dispute Case: Clarifying Compliance Boundaries for Data Exports
case.summary_en: This week, the Supreme People's Court (SPC) released typical foreign-related commercial cases, including a dispute over cross-border data flows. A Chinese tech company failed to conduct required security assessments for data exports, leading to contract breach and damages claimed by an overseas partner. The court held that data export compliance is a statutory obligation under the contract; failure to fulfill it constitutes breach. This case underscores that Chinese enterprises must treat data export security assessments and privacy impact assessments as prerequisites for cross-border contracts to avoid legal and commercial risks.
case.source_en: Source: SPC typical case release · August 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境规则衔接再提速：数据跨境流动与商事调解新规落地
policy.summary: 本周，广东省政府联合港澳方面发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动便利化指引》，在“一国两制”框架下，简化数据出境安全评估程序，对符合条件的企业实行“白名单”管理，促进科研、金融、医疗等领域数据有序流动。同时，粤港澳三地司法机构签署《商事调解合作备忘录》，推动建立统一的商事调解员资格互认与调解协议司法确认机制，为跨境商事纠纷提供高效、低成本的解决渠道。这些举措体现大湾区在规则衔接、机制对接上的实质性突破，为中国企业依托大湾区“走出去”提供制度保障。
policy.source: 来源：广东省人民政府、粤港澳大湾区门户网 · 本周
policy.title_en: GBA Cross-Border Rules Alignment Accelerates: New Measures on Data Flows and Commercial Mediation
policy.summary_en: This week, Guangdong Province and Hong Kong/Macau authorities issued the 'Guidelines on Facilitating Cross-Border Data Flows in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macau Greater Bay Area,' simplifying security assessments and introducing a 'whitelist' mechanism for qualified enterprises to enable orderly data movement in research, finance, and healthcare. Meanwhile, the three jurisdictions signed a 'Commercial Mediation Cooperation Memorandum' to mutually recognize mediator qualifications and judicial confirmation of mediation agreements, offering efficient and cost-effective dispute resolution. These measures mark substantial progress in rule alignment, providing institutional support for Chinese enterprises expanding globally via the GBA.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial Government, GBA Portal · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应构建“合规韧性”，关注美欧规则动态与供应链调整窗口
analysis.summary: 本周美欧对华限制措施呈现“技术封锁+关税施压+供应链审查”三位一体态势，中国出海企业面临合规成本上升与市场准入不确定性。秦林蒿律师建议：一、立即梳理出口管制与制裁清单适用情况，建立动态筛查机制，避免因关联交易或最终用户问题触发违规；二、针对欧盟关税终裁，评估供应链替代方案，考虑在东南亚、中东欧等地布局产能，同时利用RCEP等自贸协定优化原产地安排；三、密切关注美国301条款复审结果，提前调整对美出口策略，并利用法律救济渠道参与听证。下周关注：美国国会可能推进《2026年竞争与创新法案》对华技术限制条款，以及欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）实施细则的进一步明确。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球法律研究部 · 2026年8月7日
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Build 'Compliance Resilience' for Overseas Expansion, Monitor US-EU Rule Changes and Supply Chain Adjustment Windows
analysis.summary_en: This week's US-EU measures reflect a trio of technology curbs, tariff pressures, and supply chain reviews, raising compliance costs and market uncertainties for Chinese companies. Attorney Qin recommends: (1) promptly map applicable export control and sanctions lists, establish dynamic screening mechanisms, and avoid violations through related-party or end-user issues; (2) assess supply chain alternatives in light of EU tariff finalization, consider capacity in Southeast Asia or CEE, and leverage FTAs like RCEP for origin optimization; (3) closely track the USTR Section 301 review, adjust US export strategies, and participate in hearings. Next week, watch for US Congress's potential passage of the 'America COMPETES Act 2026' tech restrictions and further CBAM implementation details.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law Research Department · August 7, 2026
